thread:
maria_pm: Quick sync request 10 NimbusKey wants a joint marketplace listing + HSM/KMS connector launch. They want SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning in one rollout.
diego_partners: Do we have an existing HSM connector doc that covers PKCS#11 and Thales Luna?
noah_ops: We have a generic HSM guide; missing NimbusKey-specific examples. I can add a PKCS#11 sample config and topology diagram.
ellen_sec: Security note: we'll confirm FIPS-validated HSM usage for keywrap, but can't publish internal KMS endpoints. Provide architecture pattern and compliance statement instead.
maria_pm: NimbusKey requires signed assertions, SP-initiated SSO, SCIM group push for roles `researchers` and `ml-platform`. Can our SCIM handle that?
noah_ops: Yes, enterprise SCIM supports group push. I'll draft a mapping and a curl example for group provisioning.
diego_partners: Timeline: marketplace submission by 2028-04-12; embargo lift planned for 2028-04-26. Marketing needs assets a week earlier.
tara_marketing: Requirements: long description (>=300 chars), 2 screenshots, optional 20-30s demo clip. Can engineering produce a sanitized GIF of onboarding?
noah_ops: We'll record one from staging and redact PII. Show SSO button + group sync success only.
ellen_sec: NimbusKey requests 60-day cert rotation and SHA-256. I'll include a sample cron and cert generation steps.
maria_pm: Diego, confirm if NimbusKey expects the listing to claim "HSM-backed keywrap". That needs security approval.
diego_partners: They asked for that exact phrasing. Ellen?
ellen_sec: Approve the line: "Supports HSM-backed key wrapping using customer-managed FIPS-validated modules." Do not include vendor endpoints.
tara_marketing: Draft tile copy: "Redwood + NimbusKey: enterprise inference with optional customer-managed HSM keywrap, SSO (SAML), and SCIM provisioning." Need a shorter tile line too.
maria_pm: Add mention of private deployments (VPC) for regulated customers.
diego_partners: I'll request a staging SP and test org from NimbusKey today. Need test accounts to validate SAML and SCIM flows.
noah_ops: I'll produce an integration checklist: import metadata, SP-init test, signed assertion validation, SCIM group push and delta, HSM keywrap verification.
tara_marketing: Screenshots: (1) redacted SSO success page, (2) config console with redacted values. Marketplace prefers 1280x720.
marketplace_bot: Reminder: marketplace schema requires `short_description` (<=100 chars), `long_description` (>=300 chars), icons, and compliance badges if claiming FIPS. See https://marketplace.example/guide.
maria_pm: Sync Thursday 09:30 to finalize assets. Drop PRs into https://git.internal/redwood/partners/nimbuskey.
diego_partners: We'll also prepare a 2-paragraph joint press draft for embargo review.
ellen_sec: PR incoming with compliance blurb, architecture diagram, and cert rotation script by tomorrow noon.
noah_ops: I'll attach the demo GIF and test logs to the PR.
tara_marketing: On it 44d.
maria_pm: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here and flag blockers.
